# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It is 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz (122 g), with 5,000mAh and Qi2-certified 15W wireless charging. Anker markets it as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac says it is the closest alternative to Apple's MagSafe battery, and that it feels premium and runs cooler than the competition.
- It costs $54.99 and comes in several colors.
- [Buy from Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank). 9to5Mac's [roundup](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/) also lists it on Amazon at the same price.

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- It is 0.27" thick and weighs 104 g. Android Central called it the lightest, thinnest power bank the reviewer had used.
- The catch is that wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it is slow for a top-up. It also has no battery display, but you can check the charge through NFC and the app.
- Android Central lists it at $52.99 to $69.99 depending on the retailer. [Android Central review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Slim and a bit faster: ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K)**
- It is 0.35" thick and weighs 119 g, with 15W wireless charging and a semi-solid-state battery.
- It is listed at $49.99. It is a newer brand, so I'd check reviews before buying. [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**If you want more capacity: INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25W Qi2.2)**
- It is 0.5" thick and weighs about 195 g, which is slim for a 10,000mAh bank. Macworld lists it as tied for slimmest 10K.
- The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2, so this one charges at the full speed. It also has 45W wired output and a built-in lanyard-style cable.
- Android Central's table shows $54.99, but its buy links show it as low as $42.99 on Amazon, so prices vary by retailer. [Review and buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) | [Macworld's roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

## How to choose
- **Pocketability first:** Get the Anker Nano 5K. A 5K bank usually recharges a phone to about 60–75%, according to Macworld.
- **Longer days or travel:** Get the INIU 10K, which can charge a phone close to twice.
- **Cases:** Anker notes that thick or non-magnetic cases, and anything metal between the phone and charger, can interfere with charging.
